item.tib: 'jigs byed gshin rje 'khros pa'i rgyud las srid pa g.yo 'khrug bsrung bzlog bsad gsum rlung 'khor gyi man ngag gsal ba'i lde mig shog dril
item.coloph: ces dmu tsa gyer med kyis las ldan gshen la brgyud/ bdag gis (gi)sems bskyed dag pa yi/ go shog dkar la phab/ 'gal 'khrul byung na bka' skyongs srung ma rnams la bshags par bgyis/ 'dogs drug 'khrug sdeb man ngag bzhin du bya/ shog dril man ngag u ya smar ro//
